observation_summary: The test suite fails with an AssertionFailedError stating that compiler.reportCodeChange() was called even though nothing changed.
reasoning_summary: The test failure indicates that the compiler's 'reportCodeChange()' method is being invoked during a transformation pass even when no actual modifications to the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) have occurred. In the context of 'CrossModuleCodeMotion', the logic incorrectly triggers a change notification when processing empty modules or modules that do not result in code movement, violating the compiler's internal consistency check that ensures change notifications only occur when the AST is mutated.
